system.description:
Diplomatic Coordinated (from Social Amp, a condition: King Q-E4)

You move as a team, with your team.

Coordinated Words. You gain a rank of Mastery to either Deception, Persuasion or Intimidation (pick one) for the remainder of this social encounter. This becomes 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th level.

Coordinated Experience. If your Background is related to or associated with the opposing creature, you gain advantage on Insight checks.
system.summary: Mastery in Deception, Persuasion or Intimidation (picked when you get it; 2 ranks at 7th, 3 at 15th, by the Nara's level); advantage on Insight against a creature tied to your background. For the social encounter.

choose.prompt: Diplomatic Coordinated: pick the skill for Coordinated Words

rules.text: Coordinated Experience: advantage on Insight checks when your background is related to or associated with the opposing creature.
Lasts for the remainder of the social encounter; remove it when the encounter ends.
